desc: Implement the frontier min-heap greedy expansion in Python with exact integer strict inequality checks and safe handling of duplicate/stale heap entries.
Seed the heap from the starting cell's neighbors and push newly exposed neighbors whenever a cell is absorbed.
Validate the implementation on sample inputs 1-3 and edge cases such as X=1, no absorbable cells, all cells absorbable, and large integer values.
If sample validation fails, switch to an alternative batch/union-find threshold-sweep approach instead of refining the same implementation.
